acceptance: src/features/production_system/domain exposes ProductionSystem, ProductionUnit, Workflow, HumanRole, and AgentRole with validated identities and descriptive fields.
ProductionSystem rejects blank identity/name/purpose fields and duplicate unit, workflow, human-role, or agent-role identities deterministically.
Workflow preserves ordered steps and explicit ControlPoint, VerificationPoint, DecisionPoint, and ExceptionPath structures with role references.
HumanRole and AgentRole preserve responsibility/capability descriptions and AgentRole records an explicit supervision mode.
The Domain remains independent of infrastructure, interface, network, database, LLM, external source, and other feature modules.
Focused unit and integration tests cover validation, duplicate rejection, ordered workflow structure, role references, supervision mode, and control-point preservation.
The design spec and execution plan record the production-system boundary, no-goals, authorization, current-WI issue rule, and verification commands.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Keep Production System Domain independent of external systems and other feature modules.
Model production structure and responsibility as facts; do not execute agents or infer transformation scores.
Preserve human control, verification, decision, and exception points explicitly.
Do not add dependencies for this contract.
Resolve issues within the current Work Item when they remain inside its Contract scope; open a successor only for a distinct or materially expanded boundary.
Do not introduce trading, price prediction, or capital-action behavior.

intent.problem: The repository lacks a typed model for how a company creates core value through production units, workflows, human roles, and agent roles.
constraints: The Domain must model facts and responsibility without runtime execution or live deployment actions.
Workflow control, verification, decision, and exception nodes must remain explicit.
The implementation must remain provider-agnostic and use existing Rust conventions.
intent.rationale: A pure Production System model gives later Organization, Productivity, and Transformation WIs a stable structure for evaluating AI-native production rewrite evidence.
